question: which post-process exposure of the control level reproduces the viewport's fixed 'EV100 1.3' (head-tilt v3 A1 editor frames; stage-3 plan T3.1)

result.note: the match is 2^EV100 (2.4615 bisected vs 2^1.3 = 2.4623); control_scene.py uses EXPOSURE_LUMINANCE = 2^1.3. The formula 1.2/LensAttenuation*2^EV100 (3.788) is 0.9 stop darker.
